=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:111-180 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Untrusted tests share a writable `/results` mount with the gate and can forge a passing `result.json` that is accepted even when the container exits nonzero.
  WHY: The gate trusts the result status without requiring a successful container exit, allowing failed tests to be reported as passing.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1346-1401 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A shallow CI checkout may not contain the PR base SHA required by the parity helper, causing it to return an empty pending-path set and enforce strict settings byte equality.
  WHY: The reported CI run fails the settings equality check and the aggregate `lint` check; reviewers identify this as a shallow-checkout failure.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:540-549 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Selected Python test files can be run directly with `python3 <file>`, which exits successfully without executing conventional pytest test functions.
  WHY: The gate may record a pass even though the selected tests and their assertions did not run.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:120-123 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The changed-file list omits staged or unstaged edits and deletions to tracked files in the worktree.
  WHY: The wrapper snapshots the worktree but gives the selector an incomplete file list, so tests for modified tracked files may not be selected.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:131 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The source snapshot excludes or does not admit `.ai/validate.yml` and `Makefile`, although the gate reads those files to resolve test commands.
  WHY: The container can resolve a different command set or report tests unverified instead of running the repository’s declared test command.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:660-670 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Baseline reruns reuse the initial test run’s deadline, and a baseline timeout is classified as change-caused rather than unverified.
  WHY: A test failing near the end of the budget may time out on baseline and block the push as a change-caused failure; reviewers disagree on severity, with the highest assessment being MAJOR.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:919-977 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The hook checks the stamp for checkout `HEAD` without verifying that the ref or commit being pushed matches that stamped commit.
  WHY: A push can publish a different, untested local branch while passing the hook based on a valid stamp for `HEAD`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:912-918 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the guard module loads but does not recognize a push command prefixed with `command`, the hook does not use its conservative fallback detector.
  WHY: `command git push origin branch` can proceed without the hook asking for a stamp.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:evaluate_hook | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The hook checks the stamp for checkout `HEAD` and does not resolve an explicit source ref from the push command.
  WHY: `git push origin other-branch` can pass silently when a different, unstamped branch is pushed.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  expected_change_site: CLAUDE.md and workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md, §31
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: Neither file appears in the PR changed-files list or diff; the stamp command is documented in README.md and agents.d/, while the agents fragment says the §31 change remains an interactive operator step; the PR description explicitly documents this as SETUP-1, an operator step for an interactive session.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:111-112, 136-140, 149-157 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The directory the gate writes `result.json` to is the same directory the selected tests run against, allowing a test to forge a read-only passing result.
  WHY: The wrapper ignores the container exit code when validating the result, so a forged pass can be accepted.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:1346-1347, ~1393-1401 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The shallow checkout omits the base SHA required by `pending_template_paths`, causing `_settings_sync_pending` to return False and strict settings equality to fail.
  WHY: The reported check-run log shows the settings byte-equality failure and the resulting failure of the aggregate `lint` check.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `plan_units`, the `.py` branch (the `else` that appends `["python3", path]`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A selected Python test file can be run directly without executing its pytest-style test functions.
  WHY: The gate records a pass even when the changed test broke, because `python3 <file>` can exit 0 without running tests.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:121-125 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The changed-file list uses committed history plus untracked files, omitting uncommitted edits and deletions to tracked files.
  WHY: Modified tracked files may not drive test selection, causing the gate to report pass or skipped.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:131; scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py: `.ai/` (EXCLUDED), `.claude/hooks`, and the suffix allowlist (ROOT_FILES, SUFFIXES, `Dockerfile`) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The source snapshot excludes `.ai/validate.yml` and does not admit `Makefile`, although the gate reads `.ai/validate.yml`, `Makefile` targets, and `.claude` files.
  WHY: The PR tree and baseline can run different command sets, which can misclassify failures as change-caused.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `run_gate` / `classify_baseline` (shared `deadline`) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Baseline reruns use the same absolute deadline as the main run.
  WHY: A baseline timeout is classified as change-caused rather than inherited, which can block the push.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `evaluate_hook` (stamp lookup keyed on `_head(toplevel)`) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The hook checks the stamp for checkout `HEAD` rather than the ref the push publishes.
  WHY: `git push origin other-branch` can pass silently when another, untested local branch is pushed.
(No task gaps reported.)

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh: `--mount "type=bind,src=${root}/results,dst=/results"` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The wrapper mounts the results directory read-write into the container, allowing test code to forge a passing result and make it read-only.
  WHY: The gate can report a successful test run regardless of actual outcomes.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `units.append({"id": path, "file": path, "argv": ["python3", path], "kind": "test"})` | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: A Python test file is run directly without a pytest runner or explicit test invocation.
  WHY: The gate can falsely report a pass for tests that were never executed.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: `head = _head(toplevel) in evaluate_hook` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The hook checks the current checkout HEAD stamp without identifying which commits or branches are being pushed.
  WHY: A different, unstamped commit can be pushed without running the gate for it.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml: CI check for parity between .claude/ and workflow-templates/ | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: A shallow PR checkout can make the parity helper return an empty set for drifted files.
  WHY: The contract test can fail because it detects drift that the PR cannot verify against the shallow base.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py: failed re-runs of baseline unit tests use the same deadline as the initial run | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Baseline reruns can exceed the budget when the initial run consumes most of it.
  WHY: A baseline timeout can classify an inherited failure as PR-caused and block the push.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: “Document the stamp command in CLAUDE.md”; the selected PR decision assigns the matching section to both CLAUDE.md copies.
  Expected change site: CLAUDE.md and workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md, §31
  Evidence of absence: Neither file appears in the PR changed-files list or diff. The stamp instructions are delivered in README.md and agents.d/, but the specifically required §31 additions are missing.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
